data.title: Heritage Days Illness — Cases by Day
data.caption: Total 17. Cases are rising sharply. Ongoing exposure?

instructorNote: Clue inject: the chart plots cases by report date, and the caption reads reporting lag as ongoing exposure. The Epi Lead should reject it, rebuild the curve from the master onset column in 6-hour bins (MOISOP 6), and tell the Director the "rising" caption must not go into any product. Onset bins for the same 17 cases: Sat 18:00–23:59 = 0, Sun 00:00–05:59 = 5, Sun 06:00–11:59 = 6 (the peak), Sun 12:00–17:59 = 3, Sun 18:00–23:59 = 2, Mon 00:00–05:59 = 1 (Mon 03:00). With the meal served 17:00–19:30 Saturday, the peak falls about 11–19 h after the meal and is followed by a tail, which points to a single meal (point source).

citations.documentTitle: MCHD-EPI-02 — Outbreak Investigation Standard Operating Procedure
citations.quote: - **Epidemic curve.** Cases by onset in 6-hour bins for the first 3 days, then in days. The shape tells whether the exposure was a single meal (one peak within one incubation period) or continuing. -
